articles.title: From Seoul to Santiago: How Chilean Teens Are Reinventing K-Pop
articles.summary: Chilean boy band Q_ARE fuses K-pop's high-energy production with Latin identity, singing in Spanish, English, and Chilean slang. Their global fanbase and DIY ethos show how Hallyu is evolving far from Korea.

articles.title: Why Earth Is the Solar System's Ultimate VIP Planet
articles.summary: Earth's unique blend of liquid water, a protective atmosphere, and a magnetic field makes it the only known harbor for life. From continental drift to 24-hour polar days, our home planet is full of surprises.

articles.title: A Student's Daring Projection Brought the Cinerama Dome Back from the Dead
articles.summary: Ben Steinberg's grassroots campaign, including a risky projection stunt, amassed 30,000 signatures and convinced Sony to buy and reopen the iconic Cinerama Dome. Now he's setting his sights on saving the 90-year-old Bruin Theater.
